notes: Passive contextual display. Label purpose = visual aid, aria-hidden, not rendered in assistive/textonly. Info purpose = real content, announced, always-visible bar in assistive, inlined in textonly. Uses Text atom for simple content, slot for rich content. Consumer owns aria-describedby on their focusable element — Tooltip provides id on content.

text.description: Simple text content. Renders through Text atom. Mutually exclusive with rich slot content.

purpose.description: Label = visual duplicate of trigger's aria-label (hidden from SR). Info = new information (announced via aria-describedby).

id.description: Unique ID for aria-describedby linking. Auto-generated if not provided.

theme.description: Visual theme. Stripped to professional in reduced/assistive/textonly.

size.description: Tooltip max-width tier. sm = icon labels, md = help text, lg = rich content.

textTone.description: Text tone for glass/neon themes. Passed to Text atom.

entrance.description: Entrance animation. No value = instant appear. Stripped in reduced — tooltip appears instantly.
